notes: Party actions: the buttons stacked above the Formation panel in exploration. Clicking one highlights the party member best suited to it (rules/taskRecommendation.js, the same odds as the roll). Presentation only for now: nothing is rolled.

Designer decision (Oct 2026): the core actions taken on the map (the environment only; social actions such as persuading happen in conversation): Scan, Search, Analyze Tech, Repair, Force, Translate, First Aid, Attack, Interact and Use Item. Interact (e.g. pushing a button) and Use Item (using an object on something) have no task: anyone can do them, so they highlight nobody.
Designer plan (Oct 2026), not built yet: once actions work on objects, scanning an object first is how the player learns what it is and does.

PROTOTYPE PROPOSAL (Oct 2026), for the designer to edit: the labels, Attribute + Department pairings and focus lists are implementation suggestions, except where a note says Book. Difficulty is a placeholder (2) used only to rank the party; a real action would take its Difficulty from the situation.
Book: First Aid = Daring + Medicine, Difficulty 2 (STA 2e Core p.292); Ranged Attack = Control + Security, Difficulty 2 (p.290). Both match the combat data (combat/actions.json, combat/weapons.json).

Scan, Repair and Force reuse the pairings authored for the Vault of the Ancients objects (challenges.json): Sensor Sweep, Bypass Controls, Force the Door. Translate uses Reason + Science like Scan and is told apart by its focuses.
Entry: id, label, description, task = { attribute, department, difficulty, focuses [exact focus names], tags [task tags; species abilities match on these] } or no task (anyone can do it).

actions.label: Scan
actions.description: Sweep the area or an object with sensors.

actions.label: Search
actions.description: Search the area for clues, tracks or hidden things.

actions.label: Analyze Tech
actions.description: Work out how an unfamiliar device or system works.

actions.label: Repair
actions.description: Fix or jury-rig a damaged system.

actions.label: Force
actions.description: Break, lift or wrench something by strength.

actions.label: Translate
actions.description: Decipher alien writing, symbols or records.

actions.label: First Aid
actions.description: Tend an injured or defeated person.

actions.label: Attack
actions.description: Open fire on someone, starting a fight.

actions.label: Interact
actions.description: Use something directly: push a button, pull a lever, open a hatch.

actions.label: Use Item
actions.description: Use a carried item on something.
